questions.question: Why was Will having trouble finishing his homework?
options: He had lost his science book
He was waiting for the school bus
He did not know how to use a phone
questions.explanation: 威尔做科学作业时不理解地震是怎样发生的。

questions.question: What was unusual about Will's phone in his dream?
options: It had turned into a watch
It could talk and called itself QT-9000
questions.explanation: 梦中的手机自称QT-9000，不但能讲话，还能解释科学知识。

questions.question: What did QT say caused large earthquakes when plates were stuck?
options: Strong winds moving across the surface
Stored energy released when plates break free
questions.explanation: 板块边缘被摩擦阻住后突然移动，会释放积累的能量。

questions.question: Why did Will stay in the park instead of approaching damaged buildings?
options: He wanted to watch a game
He was searching for his bike
He feared aftershocks might make more parts fall
He needed a better phone signal
questions.explanation: 威尔知道强震后可能有余震，建筑物还会倒塌。

questions.question: What did Will discover when he opened his eyes after the final shaking?
options: He was back in his room with his alarm going off
He was still in the city park
His teacher was standing beside him
The cave had disappeared into the sea
questions.explanation: 余震后威尔醒来，发现自己回到卧室，手机闹钟正在震动。

questions.question: Where did Will find himself after falling asleep while studying the ocean?
options: At the top of a lighthouse
questions.explanation: 威尔在梦中醒来，发现自己身处潜水艇。

questions.question: What kind of creatures did QT say often have large eyes in the Twilight Zone?
questions.explanation: 暮光层光线微弱，那里的生物常有大眼睛以便看清周围。

questions.question: What threatened the submarine in the Twilight Zone?
questions.explanation: 巨型鱿鱼几乎用触手缠住潜艇，QT紧急转向逃脱。

questions.question: How did QT explain the glowing light on an anglerfish?
options: It was sunlight reflected from the waves
It was a light attached by fishermen
It attracted food in the dark
questions.explanation: QT解释鮟鱇鱼用头部发光器在黑暗中引诱猎物。

questions.question: Why did the submarine become unsafe near the Mariana Trench?
options: Extreme water pressure was pressing on it
questions.explanation: 潜艇下降到极深处，水压巨大，QT提示不能继续深入。

questions.question: What question did Will want to answer after visiting the museum?
options: How old his school bus was
questions.explanation: 参观完恐龙博物馆后，他想知道恐龙为什么灭绝。

questions.question: How did QT take Will through the different dinosaur periods?
questions.explanation: QT让威尔乘一架会穿越时间的飞行器，参观不同时期。

questions.question: What did QT say volcanoes might have done during the extinction?
options: Turned the oceans into fresh water
Created new caves for every species
Filled the atmosphere with ash and gases, changing the climate
questions.explanation: QT讲到一种观点：大量火山灰和气体可能改变气候，影响恐龙生存。

questions.question: What was another possible cause of dinosaur extinction discussed in the dream?
options: A worldwide drought caused by schools
A change in the length of each day
questions.explanation: 梦中还讨论了小行星撞击地球可能造成的破坏。

questions.question: What did Will notice when the dangerous crocodile seemed to grab the aircraft?
options: He woke on the bus as it stopped at school
He was standing in the museum again
The aircraft had become a canoe
QT had vanished from his pocket
questions.explanation: 飞行器受到攻击时，他醒来发现校车刚好停在学校。

questions.question: Where did QT say Will was when he woke in total darkness?
questions.explanation: QT告诉威尔，他来到肯塔基州猛犸洞穴。

questions.question: How did QT explain the formation of solution caves?
options: Slightly acidic water slowly dissolved limestone
Wind piled up sand into holes
questions.explanation: 微酸性的水穿过石灰岩裂缝，长期溶蚀形成洞穴。

questions.question: Why did QT stop Will from touching the cave formations?
options: They were made of hot lava
questions.explanation: QT提醒威尔洞穴沉积物很脆弱，触碰可能破坏。

questions.question: What adaptation did QT describe in many animals that live deep in caves?
options: They are pale because color is not useful in darkness
questions.explanation: 洞穴终年黑暗，许多动物体色很浅，无需为显眼颜色耗费能量。

questions.question: How did QT explain that bats find insects in darkness?
options: They read marks on the cave wall
They rely on sound rather than sight
questions.explanation: QT说明蝙蝠在暗处捕猎主要依靠声音，而不是视觉。
